name: cz-vat-return
description: Pointer skill for Czech VAT (DPH), tax year 2026. The full method lives in czech-republic-vat-return: registration at CZK 2,000,000 calendar-year turnover (payer from 1 January next year) and CZK 2,536,500 (payer from the next day), the 21% and 12% rates, the VAT return (přiznání k DPH), control statement (kontrolní hlášení) and EC sales list (souhrnné hlášení), monthly and quarterly periods and 25-day deadlines, domestic and cross-border reverse charge, unreliable payers, and penalties including control statement fines under § 101h of the VAT Act (235/2004 Coll.). Trigger on: Czech VAT, DPH, plátce DPH, kontrolní hlášení, přiznání k DPH. Load czech-republic-vat-return instead of this file. Out of scope here: everything; income tax is in cz-income-tax and cz-corporate-income-tax, non-residents in cz-cross-border.
